title: How to Build a Discord Bot with AI
summary: Build a Discord bot in an afternoon — welcome messages, FAQ commands, auto-moderation, and a no-code web dashboard. Database, auth, and hosting all included.
body_markdown: Yes. From the Blink project, connect to any AI API — OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google — to respond to natural language queries in specific channels. Configure the system prompt and which channels get AI responses from the web dashboard. Your API keys live in Blink's encrypted environment variables.
